name: Volumetric Display Interaction System
aliases: Direct Touch and Gestural Input System
definition: A system for interacting with a 3D volumetric display using direct touch and gestural input, leveraging the ability of users to walk around the display and interact from all directions.
summary: The Volumetric Display Interaction System enables direct touch and gestural control of 3D volumetric displays by simulating a touch-sensitive enclosure surface, differing from standard 3D cursors by respecting the display's hemispheric geometry.
